question_record.context: During a security incident, a series of events were flagged indicating suspicious sequence of exploration activities starting with a powershell script `contosoadfsblatempcreds.ps1` being executed and multiple `whoami.exe` checks being run. One notable observation was a process making use of a series of Windows commands which could be utilized to identify assets of value and coordinate lateral movement post-compromise.
question_record.question: In the final alert, who was the user account involved in attempting to hide the use of a dual-purpose tool?
solution: A process called `whoami.exe` was launched, which can be used for malicious exploration activities.
The suspicious commands were executed by a user with AadUserId `ec3ec68b-fdeb-4fe4-9a29-acd445e1ccc5`.
A known public tool that could be used for malicious purposes was observed under an unexpected filename, associated with the account `gsmith`.

32.name: Attempt to hide use of dual-purpose tool
32.description:
A known public tool, which could also be used for malicious reasons, was observed under an unexpected filename.
This might be an attempt to hide the usage of that tool for malicious purposes.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
